structuredIncident.summary: The R3 exit carrier beam fell from the yoke into the mill pit at approximately 1:03 PM on October 14, 2024 (Turn 2). The incident occurred during an outage preparation phase where work rolls and backup rolls had been removed. Key contextual facts include that the top backup roll balance was left isolated in a raised position and B hydraulics were shut off/bled prior to this shift. No team members were present in the pit at the time of impact, though witnesses observed the fall from outside. The beam assembly (beam + link) landed intact with no apparent damage or keeper failure visible immediately after recovery.
structuredIncident.focalEvent: R3 exit carrier beam falls from yoke into mill pit
structuredIncident.actualImpact: Falling object incident; potential for severe injury to personnel in the path of fall. No injuries reported at time of event, but area was red-flagged and investigation initiated.
structuredIncident.potentialImpact: Potential fatality or serious injury if a team member had been present in the pit during the unobserved interval between roll removal/hydraulic isolation and beam failure; potential damage to equipment below (sled/scaffold).
structuredIncident.normalState: During normal operation, carrier beams are supported by yokes. During outage preparation involving roll removal, specific configurations (e.g., raised balances, isolated hydraulics) may alter load paths or support conditions.
structuredIncident.eventState: Work rolls and backup rolls removed; top backup roll balance left in raised position with isolation applied; B hydraulics shut off/bled. Beam fell without prior crane activity.
